I don't have magenta complete since Virginia is unowned, so that's off the table for now. I should unmortgage Oriental and Vermont, plan to build next turn, but keep enough cash reserved in case p2 lands on my properties or I get hit by their Mediterranean/Baltic hotels or railroads. For now, unmortgaging Oriental seems like the right move.
